title: We feel in England.
html_source:
Stephen is remembering something Haines said to him earlier in Chapter 1:

We feel in England that we have treated you rather unfairly. It seems history is to blame.

anchor.prefix:
orth, my booklet, quick 
To greet the callous public. 
Writ, I ween, 'twas not my wish 
In lean unlovely English. 

 — The peatsmoke is going to his head, John Eglinton opined.
anchor.suffix:
